# ShowMore

Loads long tables in batches ("Showing 150 of 1,284 tracks" + "Show 300 more") and pages review queues with numbered pagination, without losing the reader's pl…

`SongNodes.ShowMore` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ShowMore shown={0} total={0} noun="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ShowMore" shown="{{0}}" total="{{0}}" noun="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (ShowMoreProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shown` * | `number` | Rows shown so far. |
| `total` * | `number` | Total rows matching the current filters. |
| `noun` * | `string` | Noun for the count ("tracks"). |
| `batch` | `number` | Rows added per click (default 300). |
| `showAllUpTo` | `number` | Offer "Show all" when total is at most this. |
| `onShowMore` * | `(count: number) => void` | Load the next batch; focus moves to the first new row afterwards. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | True while a batch loads. |
